text:
elaine_marketing: Drafting a concise post-webinar one-pager called 'Nexus Deploy Brief' aimed at regulated buyers. Goals: single-sheet AE handoff, three ad copy angles, and simple inbound routing for high-risk leads.

phil_growth: For ads let's A/B two CTAs first 2 weeks: 'Book a compliance review' vs 'Get SLA pricing'. Track demo quality and demo-to-opportunity conversion.

anna_sales: Handoff checklist: one-pager PDF, 2-line AE opener, 3 rebuttals, pricing band. Flag: any lead with tags (gov|health|banking|audit) -> enterprise-sdr queue.

rui_prod: Benchmarks to include (anonymized): 'Pilot: 7k context, reserved private pool p99 ~108ms; prefix caching reduced token costs ~38%.' Note hosted shared pools will have broader variance (p99 ~170-300ms).

maria_ops: Routing proposal: keyword match OR explicit form checkbox -> queue enterprise-sdr. Scoring override: estimated_arr > 150k => assign AE. Will provide webhook and mapping.

kate_content: I'll draft three micro-voice variants: 1) 'Compliance-first' (trust tone), 2) 'Performance-first' (latency + consistency), 3) 'Economics-first' (predictable spend). Each will be a short headline + one-line subhead.

phil_growth: Add UTM template: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=nexus_deploy, utm_content={cta_variant}. Also plan a paid/social cadence: rotate CTAs weekly.

anna_sales: Please include a tiny AE cheat-sheet: one-sentence value, two quick counters, where to find anonymized benchmark box in Drive.

legal_bot: Reminder: use 'contractual SLA' only for Dedicated/Private tiers. For hosted, use 'target latency' and 'published targets'. Avoid absolute latency claims for hosted public collateral.

maria_ops: Webhook example for internal routing (auth required):
POST https://hooks.redwood/internal-leads
Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "company": "<company>",
  "email": "<contact_email>",
  "tags": ["<tags>"],
  "estimated_arr": "<numeric>",
  "source": "webinar|paid_cta|social"
}

kate_content: Draft micro-copy (headline - subhead):
1) Compliance-first - "Keep keys, prove compliance." - "Private Pods with HSM and auditable logs for regulated teams."
2) Performance-first - "Consistent low-latency at scale." - "Reserved pools tuned for sub-150ms p99 on long contexts."
3) Economics-first - "Predictable costs for production AI." - "Reserved capacity + caching reduces per-token spend and smooths billing."

rui_prod: Add decision guidance box: WHEN TO RECOMMEND PRIVATE VS DEDICATED VS HOSTED:
- Private Pod: required KMS-only control, strict data residency, audited SLAs.
- Dedicated: contractual uptime and performance SLOs without customer-managed networking.
- Hosted: fastest onboarding, lower commitment, higher latency variance.

phil_growth: Timeline: one-pager draft today, legal review tomorrow AM, webhook and routing test by EOD, A/B launch Thursday.

elaine_marketing: Great. Kate will upload initial one-pager PDF and micro-copy by 5pm. Tagging @anna_sales for AE slide prep. Anything missing?
